title: IQCP: Client-Side Quantum Chemistry from SCF to Vibrational Spectra via WebAssembly

creators.name: Sawatlon, Boodsarin
creators.affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science, Chulalongkorn University, Bangkok, Thailand

creators.name: Paiboonvorachat, Nattapong

creators.affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science, Chulalongkorn University, Bangkok, Thailand

description: IQCP is a client-side quantum chemistry engine that compiles a Rust implementation of Hartree-Fock and Kohn-Sham DFT to WebAssembly, executing all numerical work directly in the browser with no server. Supports closed-shell RHF, LDA, B3LYP, and B3LYP-D3(BJ) with six basis sets for elements H-Ar; implements the full pipeline from SCF through analytical gradients, geometry optimization, PES scans, analytical Hessians, vibrational frequencies, IR intensities, semi-analytical Raman activities, and RRHO thermochemistry. Validated against PySCF 2.11.0 across 108 systems with sub-microhartree accuracy.
